method.mapGeometry: Original authored range, complex and tower maps
method.order: Alternating baseline/current legacy/current materials order per round
method.wholeStep: Uninstrumented step wall time measured around each actual Simulation.step; excludes constructing input and scene
method.component: Separate run with prototype wrappers; inclusive elapsed and self time excluding wrapped nested calls; contains wrapper/timer overhead, not subtracted
method.perception: DefenderAI.visible private runtime prototype method measured independently from DefenderAI.step; no cadence change
method.ballistics: Standalone imported function is not prototype wrapped. See QUERY_BENCHMARK-FINAL.json for exact per-ray kernel timings; this report makes no per-step ballistic attribution.

wrapperOverhead.note: Approximate no-op calibration covers a simplified timer/array wrapper. It omits prototype apply/argument creation and the full nested self-time bookkeeping, so it is not an exact cost correction. Actual component totals retain overhead; no subtraction is applied.

limits: CPU-only Node SSR workload; not browser, GPU, office or gaming hardware performance.
Current material rules intentionally change contacts/materials, so trajectory equality is checked only between frozen baseline and current legacy rules.
If a real scene kills the player, the run ends naturally and actual measured tick count is recorded.
Component self times exclude only the named wrapped nested functions, not all transitive callees.

Early repeats can show JIT/warmup variation despite the initial range warmup and 120 untimed ticks per scene. This finite series supports bounded workload/call attribution, not a conclusive whole-step speedup claim.
